create_kubernetes_api_manager: create a KubernetesApiManager instance to manage AppsV1Api and CoreV1Api clients for a given kubeconfig context
apply_k8s_manifest: apply a Kubernetes manifest dictionary to a namespace using the KubernetesNamespace apply_manifest method
wait_for_deployment_replicas: wait for a Kubernetes deployment to reach a specified number of available replicas with retry logic
port_forward_pod: forward a local port to a remote pod port using kubectl port-forward and return a Popen process
delete_k8s_namespace: delete a Kubernetes namespace with foreground propagation policy and wait for it to be fully deleted
